# Stopping native generation and physical call prefixes

Proof checkpoint: 5c75cab54612f41e4638906563f0609091a99ae1.
Verified start: a893ec92050a771d72da0e8f93c5681d5a7ece52.
Main: 9769fe3e921d63836a0be337f19edd3c601f076e.
The ff-only refresh imports no change.

NativeMuStoppingSite.execute consumes actual physical InputsThrough and
initial SemanticHeap. It selects an arbitrary exact full Mu at the actual
bounded execute Outcome.state. The result is the exact initial full cell
or one actual optionalBinder instruction. The same tuple retains the
actual yielded prefix, current physical Inputs, available body, literal
maybeMu outcome, full checked done/pending step, count/resume equation,
target None/Some, and physical and issued prefix and suffix.

The nested pending outcome maps to the actual blocked native constructor
reason and full checked advance. The operation cache remains the same.
The final blocked case has no fabricated successful suffix Trace. Its
heap suffix is reflexive. A yielded call uses its actual remaining work.
Physical WorkInputs derive that admitted Work cannot create a Mu.
No compiler owner, future return, Good, Fields or writer History is a premise.

NativeMuStoppingGeneration.execute keeps that same occurrence. It applies
the existing all-outcome OptionalGeneration.maybeMu at its exact entry and
call.state. Literal entry None excludes the local prior-cell alternative.
The generated build is binder true of encode (leaves body) [pairRef] body,
with initial inputs leaves body. Its full outcome equals the same call.
Context and the same rooted Written hold at the actual stopping heap.
The selected Mu may be a nested probe allocation. It is not required to
be the optional binder's returned value. Existing source proofs retain
their bytes and the public Written type stays the same.

NativeTracePrefixBind.bind_prefix_cases follows an actual physical yielded
prefix of bound code. It derives either the nonpure unfinished inner call
at the exact final state, or the actual inner pure return and continuation
at one exact middle state. Fuel counts add. Pure boundaries cost no step.
The result retains each original physical input check. It assumes no
future inner completion or desired split.

NativeWalkPrefix.walk_prefix_cases derives the same split for ordered calls.
Its unfinished case retains the original input index and lookup, actual
earlier Walk over take index, ordered earlier results, exact entry and
unbound current Trace. The continuation retains drop (index + 1) and
earlierResults ++ value :: tail. The completed case retains the whole
actual Walk and its outer continuation. No owner or semantic induction
hypothesis supplies this decomposition.

The actual blocked example first builds node7 containing a raw nested
Mu whose body contains pairRef and its local self. It derives Context
and body availability from actual source construction. An oracle reserves
an unused empty key and runs actual Depth and ordinary callbacks. The
real heap instead reserves the resulting outer Mu key. Both reservations
consume one identity. Kernel-checked equations prove the real callback
values equal the oracle values. That equality is not an input assumption.

The real maybeMu stops pending at the reserved outer key. Its Depth call
has installed a different full used nested Mu. The selected key was absent
at real entry and is present at the pending return. The outer record is
still absent. The checked native program has pure Work, one optionalBinder
and a later pure Work. Its actual execute stops at the sole optional call.
No earlier optional call supplies the target. One public stopping-generation
application excludes the initial arm and keeps the same returned tuple.
The witness does not replace existential operation identities with values
from a separate calculation. It proves a warm reservation case, not a
failure of fresh closed construction or a production Haskell defect.

Four public declarations and one actual example pass full statement,
proof and standard-three-only axiom readback with all eight print options.
All four imported and the constructed selected strict logs are empty.
Three canonical jobs build the four modules. Root personally observed
Audit handle 70146 at terminal exit 0: 3495 jobs and 74100 dependencies.
Its only warning is the earlier ClosedCompletion unused-input warning.

The scope has 27 actual Lean jobs and four preserved failures. Three jobs
and one failure are reused from the earlier stopping-site prototype.
There are 24 fresh jobs and three fresh failures. The other prototype
failure is the walk zero-add proof. The example retains one calculation,
two failed proof attempts, selected strict2 and full public1. Review receipt
copies add no job. All jobs use Lean 4.34.1, actual 4 GiB max/high, zero
swap and five-minute caps. Twelve jobs are root checks, ten are prototype
checks and five belong to the constructed example.

The two physical splitters close the earlier arbitrary-prefix splitting
gap. The next theorem must still derive the actual captured compileMu
owner from the SAME recovered prefix of a compiled root request. It needs
node-request, compiled-node and checked-edge prefix readers. Keep captured
and queried requests distinct until physical cache validity proves equality.
An earlier optional instruction may already have been crossed. Equal
pair, body, key or result does not identify the current occurrence.
The frozen next-owner plan gives the proposed unproved contract.

Original program binding ancestry, full-self progress, global renewal,
active-owner exclusion, outer completion, convergence and Haskell
refinement remain open. Enumeration, templates, subsumption, Specftacular,
GHC integration and replaceRows runtime correspondence keep their separate
coverage obligations. The conditional root-language and Sized laws do not
change. All 268 Haskell files, 207 active package files, older proofs,
counterexamples, repairs, drafts, stashes and other worktrees are preserved.
FINDINGS keeps the external repair handoff first. No new Haskell repair or
runtime validation is claimed. The full-library goal remains active.

prefix split and indexed walk prefix split are imported and checked.

unbound child Trace returning at the exact siteBefore. Three private
prefix readers remain: node request, compiled node and checked edge body.

Keep query and capture distinct. Physical cache validity is needed for
their equality. Keep exact full continuations and count equations.

only the current registered site; otherwise follow its real continuation.
Do not assume an owner return, owner identity or desired ancestry.
